message: Hey Mary, I hope you're doing well. I was just thinking about Emma and wanted to know if there's any news? Also, are we still on for the family reunion next month?
Morning run today was epic! You should have joined us, Mary.
Mary, your favorite cookies are ready. Swing by anytime!
Dude, did you update your phone? The new security patch is crucial!
Can't wait to see everyone at the reunion. It's been too long!
Your guitar skills are missed, man. Jam session this Friday?
Mary, I knitted a scarf for Emma to cheer her up. Let me know when you can pick it up.
Mary, remember the staff meeting is moved to 3 PM today.
I'm bringing mom's famous casserole to the reunion. Hope that's okay!
The trails are perfect right now. You should come hiking this weekend.
